policy.scope: Optimization15 only; no holdout performance or per-case diagnosis.
policy.sampling: A new driver process for each single checked-call sample; interleave actors within each pair, alternating their order by case and pair. Same driver cache flush, warmup, finite limits and checked-call timer as formal evaluation.
policy.selection: One prospective probe per exact qualified source fingerprint. Select only if equal-weight geometric mean of accepted31/candidate median seconds is strictly greater than1, visits match and original work/comparison bills do not decrease. Preserve every sample, case, regression and failure; no retries or exclusions.
policy.formal_gate: Commit and freeze selected source/driver before both formal sets. Promote only if BOTH primary Mech/C scores strictly improve.
